content.short: Sakaba is a community-first DeFi protocol on Mantle offering token swapping, liquidity provision, and yield farming for the Mantle ecosystem.
content.description: Sakaba is a decentralized finance protocol built natively for the Mantle Network community, providing core DeFi primitives including automated market making, liquidity farming, and token distribution. The protocol emphasizes community ownership and fair distribution of governance tokens to active liquidity providers and ecosystem participants. Sakaba integrates deeply with other Mantle DeFi protocols to create a composable liquidity layer that supports the broader ecosystem's growth.
